summary: 22 units reviewed; 11 verdict fix, 11 ok. Word splits and token coverage are sound throughout; the two text_flags in unit 7 are right in substance (prahartavyaḥ -> parihartavyaḥ, adṛśaṃ -> adṛśyaṃ) but one 'why' uses a false metrical argument and the other asserts an unsourced 'usual reading'. Main pattern: added connectives or emphasis the Sanskrit lacks (पर in 6, और in 10, 'and' in 18, a third where/जहाँ in 21, भी in 8, अतः for hi in 12), each confessed in the drafter's own notes, plus an added 'दूर से ही' and a voice change in the Hindi of 7. One asserted variant reading ('some editions read vai', unit 12) should be removed. No regrouping suggested; the four-line unit 31 (Mālinī) and the 21->31 jump are as the edition gives them. Confidence labels are honest (7 and 12 medium).
